content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTAMENTARY_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: I, Alice M. Smith, of Pinehill City, State of Novacore, hereby declare this to be my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_PERSONAL_PROPERTY
content_blocks.text: I give and bequeath all of my personal property to my beloved son, Michael J. Smith, free and clear of any encumbrances.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: I appoint Robert L. Johnson as the Executor of this Will and direct him to carry out the provisions hereof.
